hero.description: A journey at the crossroads of entrepreneurship, culture, media and civic engagement.

biography.title: One journey, many commitments.
biography.description: Discover the man behind the projects, responsibilities and commitments.

paragraph1.afterDate: in Eséka, in the Nyong-et-Kellé department, Simon Dupong is a Cameroonian businessman and politician.

biography.paragraph2: His journey has developed at the crossroads of entrepreneurship, community organizations, politics, media, culture and sports, with increasing involvement in various projects and responsibilities.
biography.paragraph3: From his first community initiatives to his entrepreneurial and public responsibilities, he has built a path marked by project creation, talent development and initiatives benefiting local communities.

politicalJourney.title: The key stages of a political journey.
politicalJourney.description: From his first political commitments to the creation of the Cameroon Nationalist Party, discover the key stages of his political journey.

2014.title: Entering political engagement
2014.description: In 2014, Simon Dupong took his first steps into politics within CRAC — Croire au Cameroun — under the leadership of the late Bernard Tjonga. He served for four years as National Youth Advisor.

2018.title: Mobilization around Cabral Libii
2018.description: During the 2018 presidential election, he supported Cabral Libii and created J.A.C. — Jeunesse Active pour Cabral — to mobilize and further involve young people.

after2018.title: Continuing his commitment within the PCRN
after2018.description: After the 2018 presidential election, he continued his political engagement alongside Cabral Libii and joined the PCRN, continuing the momentum built around youth involvement.

sixYears.title: Six years within the UPC
sixYears.description: He subsequently joined the Union des Populations du Cameroun (UPC), where he served for six years as spokesperson for the Secretary-General, Dr. Pierre Baleguel Nkot.

2026.title: Creation of the Cameroon Nationalist Party
2026.description: In 2026, after six years of involvement within the UPC, Simon Dupong resigned from the party and began a new chapter in his political journey with the creation of the Cameroon Nationalist Party (PNC).

engagements.title: One journey. Many fields of action.
engagements.description: Building, bringing people together, creating and passing on knowledge: the different fields that shape Simon Dupong's journey.
engagements.introduction: From entrepreneurship to culture, from media to sports, from civil society to international outreach and traditional institutions, each field reveals another facet of his journey.

societeAfrica.title: Activities serving development.
societeAfrica.description: Chaired by Simon Dupong, Société Nouvelle Afrique is a company with a capital of 100,000,000 CFA francs operating in several sectors, including construction and public procurement, microfinance, automotive, agribusiness, real estate, import-export, hospitality, tourism and travel, as well as transportation.

entrepreneurship.title: Build. Create. Develop.
entrepreneurship.description: From DUPONG Media, founded in 2015, to Groupe DUPONG Company and Société Nouvelle Afrique, Simon Dupong has developed an entrepreneurial journey spanning communication, transportation, events, real estate and other sectors.

civilSociety.title: Building connections, bringing energy together.
civilSociety.description: AMAC, ACPAN, ACOCAM, Enfants d'Eseka, Enfants de la Grotte and RECJHASCE: several associations founded around culture, media, animal protection and civic engagement.

culture.title: Helping talents grow.
culture.description: After his beginnings in music, he turned toward artistic support and cultural promotion. His journey mentions the production of more than 18 artists and the organization of several cultural events in Cameroon and internationally.

media.title: Inform, tell stories, pass on.
media.description: From television to print media, his journey includes work as a journalist, correspondent, reporter and publishing director. The media outlets mentioned include La Voix des Religions, L’Arène Hebdo and Le Grand Bassa.

sport.title: From the field to leadership.
sport.description: His involvement in sports began with rugby, where he held responsibilities in communication and youth rugby promotion. He later became involved in football with Renaissance Football Club du NK and the Nyong-et-Kellé departmental league.

international.title: Taking his commitment beyond borders.
international.description: His journey includes responsibilities related to promoting the Russian language, international reporting activities and missions in several countries. He states that he has visited all 10 regions of Cameroon and 32 countries around the world.

tradition.title: Between heritage, recognition and transmission.
tradition.description: His journey mentions several traditional distinctions, including the honorary title of Mbombock in Bassa country, that of Zomloa des Zomloa among the Ekang, and the title of Wola awarded by several kings of Western Cameroon.

0.text: A rich, committed journey focused on the future.

1.text: Strong convictions in the service of action and society.

2.text: Between heritage, responsibility and a vision for the future.

engagements.conclusion: These fields provide an overview of his journey. His responsibilities, achievements and dates can be explored in the detailed sections of the website.

awards.title: Recognition and published works.
awards.description: Official distinctions, professional recognition and publications: a selection of milestones among the achievements and awards mentioned throughout his journey.

russianLanguage.title: Best Promoter of the Russian Language in Africa Award
russianLanguage.detail: Simon Dupong received the first prize for Best Promoter of the Russian Language in Africa, in his capacity as Managing Director of the Centre Linguistique Russe du Cameroun.

workMedals.title: Medals of Honour for Labour
workMedals.detail: He received silver and vermeil Medals of Honour for Labour during the distinctions awarded on May 20, 2025.

cameroonianMerit.title: Knight of the Order of Cameroonian Merit
cameroonianMerit.detail: Simon Dupong was elevated to the rank of Knight of the Order of Cameroonian Merit.

pereNonDeclare.title: Undeclared Father
pereNonDeclare.detail: A book exploring fatherhood, family responsibilities and the social realities surrounding the role of fathers.

puberteFinanciere.title: Financial Puberty
puberteFinanciere.detail: A book focused on the management of resources, assets and businesses, with reflections on financial development and independence.

virusAccueil.title: The Virus of User Reception in Cameroon
virusAccueil.detail: A book addressing user reception and the challenges of professionalism in public and private services in Cameroon.

awards.editorialNote: These distinctions and publications represent selected milestones in a journey marked by commitment, knowledge-sharing and recognition across different fields.

impact.title: Commitments translated into action.
impact.description: Social initiatives, institutional partnerships and major projects: an overview of the initiatives presented throughout Simon Dupong's journey.

social.title: Acting close to communities.
social.description: His journey includes several initiatives in the areas of healthcare, education, access to water, public lighting, agriculture and youth support.

stats.pregnantWomen: Pregnant women supported through assistance with baby supplies and childbirth.
stats.lighting: Streetlights installed as part of public lighting initiatives.
stats.masks: Masks distributed during the Covid-19 period.

institutional.title: Training and supporting institutions.
institutional.description: The journey presented mentions several training agreements concluded with Cameroonian administrations.

customs.title: 204 customs officers trained
customs.description: Training carried out under an agreement mentioned with the Minister of Finance, Louis Paul Motaze.

forests.title: 47 forestry and wildlife officers trained
forests.description: A program carried out with the approval of Minister Jules Forest Ndongo.

police.title: More than 650 police officers trained
police.description: Training provided to police officers of different ranks, according to the information provided.

project.title: A large-scale vocational training center.
project.description: Among the projects presented is the creation of a professional training center designed to accommodate more than 3,000 learners across more than 100 technical fields. The estimated investment exceeds 3 billion CFA francs, with the ambition of contributing to youth employment and professional integration.
